# Iterra

> Iterra is a free, local-first, all-in-one study workspace for students. Eight tools — course planner, flashcards with spaced repetition, linked notes, pomodoro/focus timer, math workbench, attendance register, bubble-sheet grading, and study material organizer — unified in one browser-based environment. No account required; data lives on your device.

Canonical site: https://iterrapp.vercel.app

## Tools

- [Boxed — Time-blocking & brain-dump planner](https://iterrapp.vercel.app/tools/boxed): capture tasks, prioritize, and time-box them into your day.
- [Syllabus — Course planner & study schedule](https://iterrapp.vercel.app/tools/syllabus): terms, courses, weekly blocks, and commitments in one folio.
- [Rhythm — Habit & routine tracker](https://iterrapp.vercel.app/tools/rhythm): weekly sequencer for routines, attendance, and study cadence.
- [Flashcards — Spaced-repetition flashcard app](https://iterrapp.vercel.app/tools/flashcards): decks, active recall, quizzes, and writing drills.
- [Ink — Linked note-taking app](https://iterrapp.vercel.app/tools/ink): long-form notes with wiki-links, folders, and daily pages.
- [Margin — Study material organizer](https://iterrapp.vercel.app/tools/margin): recordings, documents, and handouts filed by course.
- [GradeStack — Quiz & bubble-sheet grading](https://iterrapp.vercel.app/tools/gradestack): build assessments, scan sheets, track score trends.
- [Timer — Pomodoro & focus timer](https://iterrapp.vercel.app/tools/timer): focus sessions, interval routes, stopwatch, and session ledger.
- [Proof — Math problem workbench](https://iterrapp.vercel.app/tools/proof): step-by-step problem solving with an error log.

All tools: https://iterrapp.vercel.app/tools
